children: Texas Ventures Acquisition III signed multiple material agreements centered on a merger with Plus Automation at an $800 million pre-money valuation, including domestication to Delaware and a new name, PlusAI Holdings. To support closing and post-merger liquidity, the SPAC lined up $63.9 million principal (net $57.5 million) of five-year convertible notes with $12.00 warrants, a ~$4.0 million PIPE of equity and warrants, and a prepaid forward for up to 1,050,000 shares with YA II PN. Shareholder alignment is reinforced through voting and sponsor support agreements, an amended registration rights framework with a 360-day lock-up, and a global guaranty of the notes by Plus and its subsidiaries.
